title: The connection came back. Did the picture?
sourceKind: source-helper replay with authored diagnostic fixtures

helper.transformation: Node stripTypeScriptTypes in strip mode; type-only import and annotations removed, trailing whitespace trimmed. Function body logic unchanged.

references.scope: Room connection state is a separate value. The public study uses a fixed connected fixture; it does not load the LiveKit SDK.
Viewer separately checks subscribed remote video and room connection. Presence of a subscribed track is not proof that useful frames are arriving.
Diagnostic source and unavailable metrics have explicit representation.

limits: Invented inputs, frozen inspection clock, two authored presentation sketches. No live stream, captured telemetry, camera/microphone access, network recovery, deployed UI change or human comprehension result. Current describes freshness/completeness of this diagnostic sample, not picture quality. Fifteen seconds is this source's rule, not a universal streaming recommendation.
